table.name: AREA_CODE_STATE
table.purpose: Lookup table mapping North American telephone area codes to the U.S. state (or territory) they belong to, likely used to derive a contestant's or voter's state from a phone number in the CONTESTANTS/VOTES context.

area_code.name: area_code
area_code.description: North American telephone area code (NANP), e.g. 201 = New Jersey, 606 = Kentucky, 845 = New York. Primary key of the table.

state.name: state
state.description: Two-letter USPS state/territory code (e.g. CA, TX, WY) that the area code is assigned to. 51 distinct values suggests the 50 states plus one territory (likely DC or PR).

table.name: CONTESTANTS
table.purpose: Roster of contestants, each with a unique contestant number that votes in the VOTES table refer to. Likely from a phone-in voting contest (given the AREA_CODE_STATE table).

contestant_name.name: contestant_name
contestant_name.description: Full name of the contestant; unique per row.

contestant_number.name: contestant_number
contestant_number.description: Primary key; unique contestant identifier (1-11), referenced by VOTES.contestant_number.

table.name: VOTES
table.purpose: One row per vote cast by a viewer via SMS/phone for a contestant in a contest (e.g., a TV-style voting show). Each vote records the voter's phone number, their state, the contestant voted for, and the timestamp of the vote.

contestant_number.name: contestant_number
contestant_number.description: Identifier of the contestant being voted for; references CONTESTANTS.contestant_number (many votes to one contestant).

created.name: created
created.description: Timestamp when the vote was recorded, stored as a string in 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS' format. All sample votes occurred within seconds of each other on 2018-03-09.

phone_number.name: phone_number
phone_number.description: Phone number of the voter (10-digit US number, stored as an integer, so leading zeros would be lost). Each vote in the sample comes from a distinct number.

state.name: state
state.description: US state (presumably of the voter/phone number) as a two-letter code (NY, CA, NJ). Note one value has a trailing newline ('NJ\n'), indicating dirty data. Likely derivable from phone_number via AREA_CODE_STATE, though no join was detected.

vote_id.name: vote_id
vote_id.description: Primary key of the VOTES table; unique identifier for each vote. Values are non-contiguous (1, 2, 3, 5), suggesting some rows were deleted or the sequence has gaps.
